brief: Reads the text or file of a knowledge document and builds the stzKnowledgeGraph it records.
detail: The document is a knowledge header with the quoted id of the graph, then sections: facts, one subject | relation | object line each, ontology, provenance and contradictions. The parser keeps no state, and it is what ImportKnow uses behind the scenes. A document with sections but no header raises error R13, and a fact line that does not hold exactly three parts is skipped.
receiver:
o1 = new stzKnowParser()
cText = 'knowledge "pantry"' + char(10) + "facts" + char(10) + "rice | isa | grain" + char(10) + "tea | isa | leaf"
